analogy.rationale: TGF-beta receptor inhibitors block a signaling pathway that is only weakly active in most of these epithelial/melanoma lines, so transcriptional changes are modest; other kinase inhibitors that impinge on overlapping growth-factor signaling (protein/tyrosine kinase inhibitors) are the closest analogs, while casein kinase and angiogenesis classes share only peripheral targets.
